name: Esportsarr
description: Consolidates per-league esports Twitch channels (LCS/LEC/LCK, VCT Americas/EMEA/Pacific) into a fixed number of generic channels per game, switching the active stream to whichever live match currently holds priority.
author: 4rn0d

fields.label: Schedule JSON URL
fields.help_text: Raw URL to schedule.json published by the scraper's GitHub Actions workflow, e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<user>/esportsarr/main/scraper/output/schedule.json

fields.label: Poll interval (seconds)
fields.help_text: How often the background scheduler re-fetches schedule.json and re-evaluates stream priority.

fields.label: Channels per game
fields.help_text: How many generic channels (e.g. "LoL 1", "LoL 2") to consolidate each game's leagues into. Must match what you ran 'Create Channels' with.

fields.label: Channel group name
fields.help_text: Dispatcharr channel group the generic channels are created under.

fields.label: LoL league priority (comma-separated, highest first)
fields.help_text: When more LoL matches are live than there are slots, leagues earlier in this list keep a slot; later ones wait for a slot to free up.

fields.label: Valorant league priority (comma-separated, highest first)
fields.help_text: Same as the LoL priority setting, for Valorant leagues.

actions.label: Create Channels
actions.description: Idempotently creates the channel group, the generic per-game channels, and the dedicated EPG source this plugin manages. Run this once before enabling the scheduler.

actions.label: Sync Now
actions.description: Runs one allocation pass immediately (fetch schedule.json, reassign stream priority) without waiting for the next poll tick. Use this to verify behavior against a known live match before trusting the automatic scheduler.
